Clustered or multilevel data structures are common in the assessment of
differential item functioning (DIF), particularly in the context of
large-scale assessment programs. This package allows users to implement
extensions of the Mantel-Haenszel DIF detection procedures in the
presence of multilevel data based on the work of Begg (1999)
\<[doi:10.1111/j.0006-341X.1999.00302.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.0006-341X.1999.00302.x)\>,
Begg & Paykin (2001)
\<[doi:10.1080/00949650108812115](https://doi.org/10.1080/00949650108812115)\>,
and French & Finch (2013)
\<[doi:10.1177/0013164412472341](https://doi.org/10.1177/0013164412472341)\>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ContigencyTables()`](https://daiscode.github.io/DIFplus/reference/ContigencyTables.md)
  : Function to create contigency tables
- [`data.adult`](https://daiscode.github.io/DIFplus/reference/data.adult.md)
  : Data Example (binary)
- [`data.adult.revised`](https://daiscode.github.io/DIFplus/reference/data.adult.revised.md)
  : Modified data.adult by removing all strata with zero marginal means.
- [`data.ordinal`](https://daiscode.github.io/DIFplus/reference/data.ordinal.md)
  : Data Example (Ordinal)
- [`ML.DIF()`](https://daiscode.github.io/DIFplus/reference/ML.DIF.md) :
  Main function to compute adjusted Mantel-Haenszel statistics
